1.title: Exam Technique and Final Review
1.text: Welcome to Module sixteen: Exam Technique and Final Review. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do three things. The pairs the exam likes to confuse. Habits that score points. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Scope: All domains. Exam format: fifty scored questions, multiple choice and multiple response; a score of seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official A W S Developer Associate (D V A-C three) exam guide.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. S Q S or S N S or Event Bridge. queue pulled by consumers or push to many subscribers or rule-based event router. Standard or F I F O queue. at-least-once and unordered or exactly-once and ordered per group. Cognito user pool or identity pool. sign-in and tokens or temporary A W S credentials. Secrets Manager or Parameter Store. rotation, billed per secret or cheap configuration, no rotation. S S E-S three or S S E-K M S or S S E-C or client-side. S three keys or K M S keys with audit or your key per request or encrypted before upload. Query or Scan (Dynamo D B). one partition key efficiently or the whole table.

1.title: The pairs the exam likes to confuse, continued
1.text: The pairs the exam likes to confuse. L S I or G S I. same partition key, table creation only or any keys, eventual consistency. Elasti Cache or D A X. cache for anything or cache for Dynamo D B. Reserved or provisioned concurrency. guarantee and cap or no cold starts. X-Ray annotations or metadata. indexed and searchable or not indexed. Code Build or Code Deploy or Code Pipeline. build and test or deploy revisions or orchestrate stages. Blue or green or canary or rolling. two environments and a switch or small share first or batches.

1.title: Habits that score points
1.text: Habits that score points. Roles, not access keys. The S D K uses role credentials; keys in code are always wrong. Managed feature first. A W S expects the built-in service (D L Q, T T L, lifecycle, rotation). Constraint words. "least operational overhead", "cost-effective", "most secure", "no code change". Multiple response. Count the answers asked, select all. A I topics. Review generated output; guardrails, private endpoints, human approval. Out of scope. Architecture design, pipeline design, I A M administration, R A G design: not tested. Exam tip: With no penalty for guessing, answer every question; flag hard ones and return with the time left. Exam tip: The fifteen unscored questions are not marked, so give every question your full attention.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A web app must stay responsive when traffic spikes and the back end is slow. What helps most? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Put work on an S Q S queue read by workers. A queue decouples and absorbs spikes.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. Which credentials should code running on Lambda use to call Dynamo D B? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: The function's execution role. Roles supply temporary credentials automatically.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A Dynamo D B table is overloaded on one partition. What is the most likely fix? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: A higher-cardinality partition key. A high-cardinality key spreads requests.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which option rotates database credentials automatically? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Secrets Manager. Secrets Manager rotates secrets.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. How should a client handle throttling errors? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Backoff with jitter relieves the service.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Which service shows where the time goes across several services in one request? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: A W S X-Ray. X-Ray traces requests across services.

1.title: Practice Question 7
1.text: Question seven. Which feature keeps A I traffic off the public internet? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: An interface V P C endpoint. Private Link keeps traffic on the A W S network.

1.title: Practice Question 8
1.text: Question eight. A release should go to ten percent of users first and roll back on alarms. What fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: A canary deployment through Code Deploy. Canary releases limit the blast radius.

1.title: Practice Question 9
1.text: Question nine. What is the minimum passing score on D V A-C three? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: seven hundred twenty. The minimum passing score is seven hundred twenty.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What is the passing score? Answer: seven hundred twenty on a scale of one hundred to one thousand. Question two. What are the four domain weights? Answer: thirty, twenty-six, twenty-two and twenty-two percent. Question three. Which domain is new in A I content? Answer: A I appears across domains, with Task two point three (securing A I services) entirely new.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What is the default S Q S visibility timeout? Answer: thirty seconds. Question five. What does a Cognito identity pool provide? Answer: Temporary A W S credentials. Question six. What is the Lambda timeout limit? Answer: fifteen minutes.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Exam: fifty scored plus fifteen unscored, seven hundred twenty to pass, no guessing penalty, multiple response needs all answers. Domains: thirty development, twenty-six security, twenty-two testing and deployment, twenty-two troubleshooting and optimization. Habits: roles, managed features, backoff and jitter, least privilege, review A I output. Always: answer every question. If this course is helping you, please subscribe to the channel and hit the bell icon, so you get a notification when the next video is out. That completes the course. Good luck with the exam.
